title: I’ve Been Running the New Safari on iOS 27, and My Thumbs Are Already Happier
summary: I usually wait until the full release of iOS before updating my iPhone . In iOS 27’s Safari Compact toolbar, the All Tabs icon replaces the three-dot menu of iOS 26, which is exactly where it should have been all along.
